description: React component 'TestCases' for managing and displaying test cases. It includes functionality to load test cases by SRS ID, trigger generation of test cases, and poll their status.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches test case data from API based on current SRS ID.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers generation of test cases for the current SRS ID and starts polling for updates.

methods.name: startPolling
methods.description: Sets up periodic polling to refresh test case data.

methods.name: stopPolling
methods.description: Clears the polling interval to stop periodic data refresh.

search-terms: API test cases load and generate
